title: Reinstatement Standing Reduction for Households in Good Payment Standing
content:
Training note on Parking License reinstatement. The reinstatement fee is reduced for a household whose Apartment Home Lease is free of a certified-funds restriction, and reduced further when proof of renter's insurance is on file.

**What is the rule?** When the lease is not restricted to certified funds and proof of renter's insurance is on file, the reinstatement standing reduction is $10.00; when the lease is not restricted to certified funds and no proof of renter's insurance is on file, the reinstatement standing reduction is $5.00; in every other case there is no reinstatement standing reduction. The reinstatement standing reduction is subtracted from the reinstatement fee, and the reinstatement fee is never below zero.

**Which records decide?** Two entries on the Apartment Home Lease: whether the lease is currently restricted to certified funds for payments, and whether proof of renter's insurance is currently on file.

**How do the two combine?**

| Apartment Home Lease restricted to certified funds | Proof of renter's insurance on file | Reinstatement standing reduction |
|---|---|---|
| no | yes | $10.00 |
| no | no | $5.00 |
| yes | yes | none |
| yes | no | none |

**And if the reduction exceeds the fee?** *Hypothetical:* a reinstatement fee of $8.00 before this reduction, less $10.00, stands at $0.00.
